directAnswer: You can move contacts to a new phone by syncing them with a cloud service or transferring them via a SIM card. Ensure both phones are compatible with the chosen method.
summary: Transferring contacts to a new phone can be done through cloud services, SIM card transfers, or using specific apps designed for this purpose.

sections.heading: Using Cloud Services
sections.body: Sync your contacts with a cloud service like Google Drive or iCloud. This method is ideal for seamless transfers across devices.

sections.heading: Using a SIM Card
sections.body: If both phones use the same type of SIM card, you can transfer contacts directly by inserting the old SIM into the new phone.

sections.heading: Using Transfer Apps
sections.body: Apps like 'Move to iOS' or 'Samsung Smart Switch' can help you transfer contacts and other data easily between devices.

steps.title: Sync Contacts with Google (Android)
steps.detail: On your old phone, go to Settings > Accounts > Google > Account sync and enable 'Contacts'. On your new phone, log into the same Google account to sync.

steps.title: Sync Contacts with iCloud (iPhone)
steps.detail: On your old iPhone, go to Settings > [your name] > iCloud and toggle on 'Contacts'. On your new iPhone, sign in to the same iCloud account to sync.

steps.title: Transfer via SIM Card
steps.detail: On your old phone, go to Contacts > Settings > Export to SIM. Insert the SIM into your new phone and import contacts from the SIM.

steps.title: Use Transfer Apps
steps.detail: Download a transfer app on both phones, follow the on-screen instructions to connect the devices, and select contacts to transfer.

faqs.question: What if my new phone is from a different brand?
faqs.answer: You can still transfer contacts using cloud services or transfer apps that support multiple brands.

faqs.question: Will I lose my contacts if I reset my old phone?
faqs.answer: If your contacts are synced with a cloud service, they will remain safe and can be accessed from your new phone.

faqs.question: Can I transfer contacts without an internet connection?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use a SIM card or a direct transfer app that doesn't require internet access.

caveats: Ensure both phones are compatible with the chosen transfer method, as some features may vary by brand and model.
